digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767), silently truncating comments longer than 32767 chars on instances where an admin has raised jira.text.field.character.limit above the default

when jira.text.field.character.limit is configured higher than 32767 or set to 0 (unlimited), rebar still truncates at 32767, causing silent data loss despite operator visibility via sanitizers.py warning
the DC comment ceiling must be made configurable via ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars with default 32767 and range 0-2147483647 to match jira.text.field.character.limit's documented bounds
sanitize_comment previously reused the description fitter (fit_outbound), creating a latent trap where future changes to description fitting could catastrophically retarget comment truncation rules
the fix decouples comment sanitization from description fitting and ensures send-side and differ-side transforms converge through one truncation function and one configurable ceiling
